title: Create a UI library
description: Creates an Angular UI library inside an existing domain.

name.description: UI library name, for example button.
name.x-prompt: What UI name would you like to use?

domain.description: Existing domain name, for example booking. Omit this to place the library in shared.

directory.description: Optional nested path under the domain folder where the UI library is created.

skipPrefix.description: Skip the ui- prefix in the project name and folder. Same as --skip-prefix.

dryRun.description: Preview the changes without updating files. Same as --dry-run.
